answer: Governed breakdown for 2026-01-01 through 2026-08-31 across 4 group(s): Southeast: revenue $92,587,901.74, operating margin pct 34.12%; Northeast: revenue $66,284,779.53, operating margin pct 39.84%; Midwest: revenue $58,055,888.43, operating margin pct 38.71%; West: revenue $51,474,889.90, operating margin pct 33.83%.
sql: SELECT SUM(wm_finance_monthly.revenue) AS waste_revenue, 100.0 * SUM(wm_finance_monthly.operating_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(wm_finance_monthly.revenue), 0) AS waste_operating_margin_pct, wm_customers.region AS region FROM wm_finance_monthly LEFT JOIN wm_contracts ON wm_finance_monthly.contract_id = wm_contracts.id LEFT JOIN wm_customers ON wm_contracts.customer_id = wm_customers.id WHERE wm_finance_monthly.month >= '2026-01-01' AND wm_finance_monthly.month < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY wm_customers.region LIMIT 5000
